epistemic_status.INFERRED: For a finite state set and fixed query suite, each distinct observation signature requires a distinct predictive class. The quotient is therefore the coarsest exact encoding for this protocol, but not for untested horizons or inputs.
epistemic_status.OBSERVED: Exp47 all_states() is a Cartesian product of 21 count levels, 9 association levels, 2 link values, and 4 recency levels (1,512 states). This is not generated by reachability from its history seed. The pinned Exp47 artifact verified with canonical SHA256 a340d939e0ef41ab2090d5efb94492161108894c2275118168720d187b17dfd7.
epistemic_status.PROPOSED: This assay defines reachability from the documented Exp47 history seed under every C/K choice, and defines observational equivalence by exact choice, propagation, and causal-contribution traces over the same 24 schedules.
epistemic_status.UNKNOWN: Whether this finite quotient corresponds to reachable states or predictive equivalences in Raven, MNEME, or deployed agent memory.

limits: The quotient definition makes class count equal to distinct signatures by construction; evidence comes from exact enumeration and checked witness pairs. The reachability closure starts from one Exp47 history seed and explores all C/K choices, not every conceivable history. The quotient is specific to 24 finite schedules and the listed observables; it is not a universal minimal-state proof.

minimality_statement.lower_bound_argument: Any exact predictor must assign distinct representations to states with different output signatures, or it would give the same prediction to at least one probe with different observed output. One representation per signature achieves that bound for the enumerated set.
minimality_statement.reason: The quotient only distinguishes traces for the fixed finite schedule set; it need not be transition-stable for arbitrary future inputs.

protocol.equivalence: Two states are equivalent iff their exact traces agree for every fixed probe schedule.

reachability_audit.reachability_scope: Closure under arbitrary C/K choices from one documented seed; not all possible initial histories.

exp47.use: State product, deterministic transition, 24 probe schedules, and observations.

title: Finite-protocol observational quotient
